subject.title: Voice transcript recovery turn generates response but delivery-mirror drops Telegram reply

question: Should this issue wait for a fresh live Telegram voice-transcript replay before assigning a fix, or is maintainer-held source/log evidence enough to choose the repair boundary now?
rationale: The report is plausible and high impact, but read-only source review did not identify the exact failing boundary well enough for a safe automated fix PR.

options.title: Require live replay first
options.body: Capture a redacted Telegram voice-message recovery run showing transcript generation, assistant final content, delivery accounting, and the missing Telegram reply before queuing code work.

options.title: Assign from private logs
options.body: If maintainers have private logs that already isolate the failing boundary, route a narrow repair using those logs as proof.

options.title: Treat as adjacent only
options.body: Do not act on this issue until related Telegram fallback and queued-delivery fixes land and the reporter can confirm whether the voice recovery symptom remains.

recommendation.title: Require live replay first
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted Telegram voice-message recovery run showing transcript generation, assistant final content, delivery accounting, and the missing Telegram reply before queuing code work.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-source blame and broad recent ownership make this the best available routing candidate for deciding proof sufficiency, even though the root cause may land in adjacent Telegram or reply-run files.
